annotations.title: Get a link to start the online assessment

description: Returns the link where the patient starts their own online assessment, and the steps they must do themselves. Give the link to the patient. Do not fill in the assessment for them. If you pass a state the clinic doesn’t serve, you get the list of states it does serve instead of a link.

medication.description: naltrexone (alcohol) or varenicline (smoking, vaping or nicotine pouches).

plan.description: quarterly (the default) or annual. Only naltrexone has an annual plan.

state.description: Two-letter USPS code of the state the patient lives in, for example PA. Use DC for Washington, D.C.

name: get_start_link
